one_line: Explore a jungle island: build a deck of cards, send workers to dig sites, and race up the temple research track.
Work as a team to stop four diseases spreading around the world. Everyone wins or loses together.
Roll dice as giant monsters to smash rivals and score points. First to 20 points or last one standing wins.
Pick a fantasy race with a random power, grab land, then send it into decline and start a new one.
